holds.item: BUS/TANK termination, grip and electrical performance after nominal route closure
holds.closure: Four R32 routes, wall apertures, grommets and bolted blocks are modeled. Finalize native-pad solder tails/boots and actual capacitor lead projection; choose and qualify guide/grip materials and pull force. Verify voltage waveform rating, transfer function, parasitic capacitance, common-mode pickup, EMI and fault behavior. Longer routes are not electrically accepted by CAD.

holds.item: Front guard / sloped user-control rear lid
holds.closure: Confirm proposed budget with fabricator and mechanical engineer: guard/support0.30, lid/chassis location0.40, differential hot displacement0.20 mm. This is an allocation target, not measured process capability; investigate actual hot states before accepting.

Confirm lead projection/forming, board warp and standoff dimensions from supplier. No insulation rating follows from the resulting air gap; actual working voltage determines clearance, creepage and solid insulation.

holds.item: Insulating panels, top barrier, posts and sensor trays
holds.closure: Select exact material, thickness tolerances, temperature/tracking/flammability properties and fasteners. Mechanical coupon verifies thread retention, harness forces, service cycles and hot deformation. A nominal blank is not qualified solid insulation.

holds.item: Concrete support ECO process and load verification
holds.closure: Candidate floor drilling, catch guard screws, OUT brackets and pod support frames are modeled with explicit fastener patterns. Validate drawing tolerances, bracket/frame displacement, insulating thread creep and service cycling. Historical floor remains unchanged; use only the candidate floor matching the assembly hash. The rejected 0.25 mm OUT slot is not an accepted alternate.
Obtain actual AC1005/AC1020 samples/vendor CAD, verify lead seating/bore, restrained conductor diameter and bend geometry; keep burden/TVS local. Body envelope is not a wiring model.
Obtain exact rail, clips, boots, conductor sizes, clamp torque and bend radii; verify terminal service with central panel removed. KPA/KPB remain additive proposal pending electrical acceptance.
Correlate HS400 plate/cutoff contact coupons, fault temperatures and plume with cards/panels/cables. Existing cold geometry does not establish hot surface or enclosure safety.

Assign actual mains, CATCH_P, tank and SELV domains and working/transient voltages; engineer barriers/feedthroughs/creepage/clearance/touch protection and dedicated PE bonds. Neither a STEP intersection result nor a nominal8mm PCB rule is acceptance.

Verify exact distances in support-critical-distances.json. Establish <=0.60 mm combined adverse fabrication, placement and hot/load movement; confirm actual PE conductor stays within its reservation. This is mechanical separation, never insulation acceptance.
